tool.name: pmotools extract_pmo
tool.description: Extract subsets of a PMO by metadata, specimens, library samples, targets, or read filter
tool.command: pmotools-python ${extract_type.extract_command} --file '$input_pmo' --output '$output_pmo' --overwrite #if str($extract_type.extract_command) == "extract_pmo_with_selected_meta": --metaFieldsValues '$extract_type.metaFieldsValues' $extract_type.verbose #elif str($extract_type.extract_command) == "extract_pmo_with_select_specimen_names": #if str($extract_type.specimen_names_source.specimen_names_source_selector) == "text": --specimen_names '$extract_type.specimen_names_source.specimen_names' #elif str($extract_type.specimen_names_source.specimen_names_source_selector) == "file": --specimen_names '$extract_type.specimen_names_source.specimen_names_file' #end if $extract_type.verbose #elif str($extract_type.extract_command) == "extract_pmo_with_select_library_sample_names": #if str($extract_type.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names_source_selector) == "text": --library_sample_names '$extract_type.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names' #elif str($extract_type.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names_source_selector) == "file": --library_sample_names '$extract_type.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names_file' #end if $extract_type.verbose #elif str($extract_type.extract_command) == "extract_pmo_with_select_targets": #if str($extract_type.targets_source.targets_source_selector) == "text": --targets '$extract_type.targets_source.targets' #elif str($extract_type.targets_source.targets_source_selector) == "file": --targets '$extract_type.targets_source.targets_file' #end if $extract_type.verbose #elif str($extract_type.extract_command) == "extract_pmo_with_read_filter": --read_count_minimum '$extract_type.read_count_minimum' #end if

param.name: metaFieldsValues
param.label: Metadata field=value selection
param.help: Format: field1=value1,value2,value3:field2=value1,value2. Or a tabular file with columns field, values (and optionally group)

param.name: specimen_names_file
param.label: Specimen names file
param.help: Plain text file with one specimen name per line

param.name: library_sample_names_file
param.label: Library sample names file
param.help: Plain text file with one library sample name per line

param.name: targets_file
param.label: Target names file
param.help: Plain text file with one target name per line

param.label: Minimum read count
param.help: The minimum read count (inclusive) for detected haplotypes to be kept

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Extract from PMO**
Extracts subsets of a PMO file using one of several methods:
- **By metadata**: Extract samples and haplotypes matching selected metadata field=value pairs (e.g. `collection_country=Mozambique:collection_date=2018-06-07`) - **By specimen names**: Extract specific specimens by name (comma-separated or from a file) - **By library sample names**: Extract specific library samples by name (comma-separated or from a file) - **By target names**: Extract specific targets by name (comma-separated or from a file) - **By read count filter**: Keep only haplotypes with at least the specified minimum read count
